title: Performance Review
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight demonstrates a fitness orb to Jim, Michael discusses Jan's visit and their past relationship, and Jan emphasizes her professional boundaries. Michael and Jan have a complicated interaction involving kissing and business, while Jan states she is not in a place for a relationship and will conduct the review over the phone. Dwight arrives late, and there are ongoing tensions and uncertainties regarding Michael and Jan's relationship and the outcome of the performance review.

main_threads.thread: Michael and Jan's relationship and interactions

Michael: Pam, I have ideas on a daily basis. I know I do. I have a clear memory of telling people my ideas. Um, is there any chance you wrote any of my ideas down? In a folder? ...

Dwight (running through parking lot): I'm here! I'm here! I'm here! It's ok!
